safeguards.heading: What the law asks for
safeguards.intro: The EU AI Act sets duties for those who build and deploy AI. These are the safeguards that matter most to the people affected.
items: Notice and transparency when AI is used in defined cases.
Information about an AI system’s purpose and limitations.
Risk management and documentation by those who deploy AI.

mission.heading: AI can serve people, not just profit.
mission.body1: AI already helps decide who gets an interview, which patient is seen first and whether a claim is approved. When the only question is whether it pays, people get left out.
mission.body2: We believe in AI that is human first: people stay in charge, decisions can be explained, and you don’t need to be an engineer to have a say.
